parts.name: Concealed Removable Hinge
parts.summary: Southco F6-3-1 is a deep-offset concealed hinge assembly in passivated stainless steel. The F6 family supports removable-door arrangements while keeping the hinge concealed when the enclosure is closed.
parts.check: Check the frame offset, door-leaf clearance and mounting arrangement against the existing enclosure. Include a drawing or installation photo if you are identifying a replacement hinge.

parts.name: Versa-Latch Draw Latch
parts.summary: Southco V4-0006-52 is a short-blade Versa-Latch with unrestricted access. Its spring-loaded design is intended to accommodate variation between the panel and frame.
parts.check: Confirm the blade geometry, keeper position and mounting spacing. Include the required material and finish on your inquiry so Webson can verify the configuration before quotation.

parts.name: Removable Lift-Off Hinge
parts.summary: Southco 96-50-510-50 is a lift-off hinge with an offset knuckle and concealed mounting. This zinc-alloy version has a black powder-coated finish.
parts.check: Check the knuckle offset, hinge orientation and concealed mounting pattern. Allow sufficient clearance for the door to lift off in the intended installation.

parts.name: Key-Locking Sealed Lever Latch
parts.summary: Southco C5-21-35 combines a recessed lever with key-controlled access. This black zinc-alloy compression latch accommodates panels from 1 to 11 mm thick and a 29 to 45 mm grip range.
parts.check: Check both panel thickness and grip, as they describe different installation dimensions. Include keying requirements and any sealing accessories needed for your enclosure; sealing performance depends on the complete installation.

parts.name: Fast-Lead Receptacle
parts.summary: Southco 12-11020-13 is a medium-size, flat, rivet-mounted receptacle made from passivated stainless steel. It is the mating receptacle in a fast-lead fastening system, rather than a captive screw or a complete fastening assembly.
parts.check: Identify the mating stud, retainer and panel/frame thicknesses when reviewing a complete assembly. Send the existing component numbers with your RFQ so the receptacle can be checked within the intended fastening system.

parts.name: Over-Center Draw Latch
parts.summary: Southco V7-20-101-50 is a large, non-locking over-center draw latch. The zinc-alloy body has a black powder-coated finish and a low-profile form for exterior mounting.
parts.check: Verify keeper geometry, mounting-hole pattern and the latch-to-keeper spacing. If access must be restricted, identify that requirement separately because this listed configuration is non-locking.

parts.name: Grabber Catch Latch
parts.summary: Southco C3-805 is a black plastic grabber catch with rivet or screw mounting and no microswitch. The spring-loaded mechanism provides push-to-close operation with pull-to-open access.
specs: Push to close; pull to open
parts.check: Check the keeper alignment and mounting positions. If a release or pull-up force is specified on your drawing, send that requirement with the RFQ for confirmation. Identify separately whether a door-position switch is required.

parts.name: Large Snap-In Flush Pull
parts.summary: Southco P2-54 is a large black ABS flush pull for 2.1 to 2.5 mm door thickness. The snap-in design retains the handle at the panel opening without separate mounting screws.
parts.check: Measure the panel thickness at the cutout and check the opening geometry. P2-54 and P2-43-1 differ in size, panel range and material flammability classification; they should be reviewed as separate configurations.

parts.name: VISE ACTION® Compression Latch
parts.summary: Southco E3-16-21 is a large VISE ACTION compression latch with an 8 mm hex recess. This version uses a zinc-alloy body with a bright chrome-plated finish.
parts.check: Check the grip range, cam configuration, panel thickness and rotation required by your drawing. A matching head style does not establish that another E3 configuration has the same fit.

parts.name: Small Snap-In Flush Pull
parts.summary: Southco P2-43-1 is a small snap-in flush pull in black ABS plastic. It fits 1.8 to 2.1 mm panels and uses the UL94-V0 material option.
parts.check: Confirm the small-size cutout dimensions and panel thickness before ordering. Retain the complete -1 suffix when requesting this material option.

parts.name: Screw-Mounted Flush Pull
parts.summary: Southco P1-33 is a recessed black ABS pull with screw mounting and a two-piece cup arrangement. The listed configuration fits 1.8 to 3.3 mm panels and uses the UL94-V0 material option.
parts.check: Check the panel cutout, thickness and rear clearance for the cup. The screw-mounted P1 arrangement differs from the snap-in P2 style even when both are described as flush pulls.

parts.name: Constant-Torque Positioning Hinge
parts.summary: Southco E6-10-208-50 is a medium-size constant-torque hinge with symmetric resistance. Its nominal torque is 0.9 N·m in each direction, and the aluminum-alloy hinge has a black finish.
parts.check: Review component weight, center of gravity, hinge quantity and mounting geometry when selecting a positioning hinge. Preserve E6-10-208-50 exactly; a similar part number with an added letter identifies a different configuration.

parts.name: VISE ACTION® Compression Latch
parts.summary: Southco E3-16-35 is a large VISE ACTION compression latch with an 8 mm hex recess and black powder-coated zinc-alloy construction. Its adjustable grip range is 38.9 to 54.6 mm.
parts.check: Confirm the full grip range, cam geometry and rotation against the drawing. E3-16-21 has a different finish and must be checked independently for grip and configuration before considering it as an alternative.

families.Hinges: Choose between door removal and position holding. F6 concealed hinges, 96 lift-off hinges and E6 constant-torque hinges serve different installation needs.
families.Compression latches: Review grip, panel thickness and actuation together. The listed range includes C5 key-locking lever latches and E3 VISE ACTION latches with tool access.
families.Draw latches: Check the latch and keeper as a system. V4 Versa-Latch and V7 over-center designs offer different profiles and mounting arrangements.
families.Grabber catches: For push-to-close and pull-to-open access, identify the catch, keeper and mounting arrangement together.
families.Flush pulls: P1 screw-mounted and P2 snap-in pulls provide recessed hand access. Match the cutout, panel thickness and material option to the complete part number.
families.Fast-lead hardware: Keep mating components distinct. A receptacle, stud and retainer have separate designations and must be selected for the complete panel and frame arrangement.
